describe: Guess a hidden word, with per-letter feedback. Listens to the keyboard fragment's input `press {letter}`: a letter is added to the typed word (`typed`) until it has `length` letters, then it is submitted automatically; the letter '<' (add it to the keyboard's `letters`) deletes the last typed letter. The game must provide state `answer` (string, lowercase, exactly `length` letters; usually picked from a content list). A submitted guess is kept in `guesses` and drawn as a row of dots: right place ($primary), in the word elsewhere ($accent) or absent (grey); a guess equal to `answer` sets `solved` and emits `word_solved`, any other emits `guess_wrong`. Provides `key_state(letter)` for the keyboard (0 untouched, 1 used and in the word, 2 used and absent) and `letter_mark(guess, c)` (2, 1 or 0 for letter c of a guess). Running out of `max_guesses` without solving loses. With on_solved 'win' the game is won when solved; with 'none' the game decides (for example emit `word_reset` after setting a new `answer` to start another word, which clears the board). Draws a status line and the guess board; `y` is the board's top. Sets no score.

letter_mark.body: let ch = get_or(chars(guess), c, '') in if ch == get_or(chars(answer), c, '') then 2 else if contains(chars(answer), ch) then 1 else 0

key_state.body: if not any(guesses, g => contains(chars(g), letter)) then 0 else if contains(chars(answer), letter) then 1 else 2

_cell_letter.body: if r < len(guesses) then get_or(chars(guesses[r]), c, '') else if r == len(guesses) then get_or(chars(typed), c, '') else ''

_cell_mark.body: if r < len(guesses) then letter_mark(guesses[r], c) else -1

rules.when: event.letter == '<' and not solved and len(chars(typed)) > 0
event.letter != '' and event.letter != '<' and not solved and len(guesses) < @max_guesses and len(chars(typed)) < @length

node.text: = if solved then 'Got it!' else 'Guess ' + str(min(len(guesses) + 1, @max_guesses)) + ' of ' + str(@max_guesses)

children.fill: = if _cell_mark(cell.y, cell.x) == 2 then $primary else if _cell_mark(cell.y, cell.x) == 1 then $accent else if _cell_mark(cell.y, cell.x) == 0 then '#9AA0A6' else $surface
